summary: Test plugins evaluate expressions to True or False for use in conditionals in tasks, blocks, plays and roles. Ansible includes Jinja's tests plus its own, and custom ones can be written.
questions: What is a test plugin in Ansible?
Can I write my own Jinja test?
Does Ansible support standard Jinja tests?

answer_card.title: What test plugins are
answer_card.answer_md: Test plugins evaluate an expression and return True or False, for use in conditionals. Ansible includes Jinja's standard tests plus specialized ones, and you can write custom tests.
